justification: Both surfaces include a carved circular disc motif and bands of geometric patterning, but A depicts an abstracted anthropomorphic figure (head, arms, belt) while B depicts a register-based frieze with animal figures (bird-like creatures, a quadruped) and arch shapes, a fundamentally different iconographic program. The biggest difference is that A's composition is organized around a single human body plan, whereas B is a horizontal narrative sequence of animals and abstract bands with no human figure discernible.
